projects.title: Malabna – Football Field Booking & Community App
projects.bodyText:
- A **football field booking and community app** designed to make finding and booking football fields easier.
 - Users can **discover nearby fields**, check available booking times, book fields, make payments, and connect with other players through the community.
 - Field owners can manage their fields, bookings, available time slots, and earnings.

projects.title: Egypt Railway – Desktop Website Redesign
projects.bodyText:
- A modern **redesign concept** for the Egypt Railway website, focused on improving the user experience and making train booking and railway services easier to navigate.
 - Includes redesigned screens for **searching and booking tickets**, train details, and **live train tracking**.
 - Also covers user bookings, authentication, and customer support flows.
